1.title: Trump’s Open Claims That He Directs Super PAC Spending Draw Watchdog Complaint
1.summary: Federal law bars those holding federal office from directing spending decisions for a political organization with no contribution limits.

2.title: Civil Rights Groups Sue to Keep Armed Agents Away From Voting Sites
2.summary: The lawsuit argues that the Trump administration’s immigration enforcement and suggestions that it could send agents to polling stations violate the Voting Rights Act.

3.title: Resident Evil movie director says he was not prepared for fan backlash
3.summary: The video game adaptation is a hit with critics, but director Zach Cregger says the fan response surprised him.

4.title: German Art Institutions Prepare for a Fight as Far Right Looks to Take Power
4.summary: As the Alternative for Germany party seeks to control a state government for the first time, its push for “patriotic” art has drawn comparisons with Nazi policies.

5.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
5.summary: The French president says he has tasked the government with protecting critical infrastructure and defence industry sites.

6.title: 37 Miners in Nigeria Die in Police Custody, Sparking Protests
6.summary: One survivor told The New York Times that dozens were packed into a single cell with barely any ventilation, food, or water.
